title: Juicy Herbal Borlotti Tagine
description: A flavorful and nutritious Saudi-Arabian style tagine made with borlotti beans, herbs, and spices, perfect for a comforting solo dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the tagine pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the borlotti beans, saffron threads, cumin seeds, coriander seeds, and bay leaf.
Pour in 200ml of water, cover the tagine, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 25 minutes, or until the borlotti beans are al dente and the liquid has reduced.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
